title: 시니어 브랜드 제휴 매니저
raw:
[담당 업무]
•      Identify, pitch, negotiate, and close commercial brand partnerships with leading brands in FMCG and Retail, and other non-endemic partners as the need arises.
•	Manage existing client relationships transitioned into your portfolio and explore new collaboration opportunities.
•	Work closely with Shanghai teams, global branding, legal, and regional BD teams to align on creative concepts, contract terms, and project milestones.
•	Formulate business proposals, evaluate commercial deal terms (minimum guarantees, royalties, co-marketing budgets), and build solid business cases.
•	Oversee partner campaign execution alongside internal teams to ensure asset quality, IP guideline compliance, and timely delivery.
•	Attend industry events, trade shows, licensing expos, and partner meetings as needed.

1，识别、接洽、谈判并促成与快消品和零售行业领先品牌的商业品牌合作，并根据需要拓展其他非本行业（non-endemic）合作伙伴。
2，维护现有客户关系，并开拓新的合作机会。
3，与上海团队、全球品牌部、法务部及区域 BD 团队紧密协作，对齐创意概念、合同条款和项目里程碑。
4，制定商业提案，评估商业合作条款（保底金额、版税分成、联合营销预算），并构建扎实的商业论证。
5，与内部团队共同监督合作伙伴活动的执行，确保素材质量、IP 规范合规和按时交付。
6，根据需要参加行业活动、贸易展会、授权博览会及合作伙伴会议。

[지원 자격]
Requirements:
•	at least 3 years of experience in brand partnerships, business development, or IP licensing, preferably within gaming, entertainment, FMCG, retail, or agency environments.
•	High level of professional proficiency in both Chinese and English (spoken and written) is required. You must be comfortable presenting to external international partners in English and working with HQ internal teams in Chinese.
•	Proven track record of closing and managing cross-industry brand collaborations, especially in FMCG (F&B, lifestyle) or Retail chains.
•	Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
•	Good business acumen with a solid understanding of commercial terms and licensing contracts.
•	Strong organizational skills, self-motivated, and comfortable working across matrixed teams.
•	Passion for gaming and familiarity with HoYoverse titles and ACG culture.
 
Preferred Qualifications:
•	Experience working with multinational companies or managing international partner projects.
•	Established network of brand contacts across F&B, consumer packaged goods, or retail chains.
•	Familiarity with co-branded packaging, retail activations, or promotional redemption campaigns


1，至少 3 年品牌合作、业务拓展或 IP 授权经验，优先考虑游戏、娱乐、快消、零售或代理机构背景。
2，中英文均需达到较高的专业水平（口语和书面）。你必须能够用英语向外部国际合作伙伴做演示汇报，并用中文与总部内部团队协作。
3，有促成并管理跨行业品牌合作的成熟履历，尤其是在快消（餐饮、生活方式）或零售连锁领域。
4，具备出色的谈判、沟通和演示能力。
5，具备良好的商业敏锐度，对商业条款和授权合同有扎实的理解。
6，具备较强的
summary: 경력 3년 이상 · 상하이 · 중국어 원문. 언어: 중국어 비즈니스 (업무 언어). 서브컬처 우대.
